_comment: Curated from MDN's SVG and MathML references. Element entries carry only their element-specific attributes; the shared presentation attributes live in svgPresentationAttributes and apply to every SVG-namespace element at lookup time.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: fill
svgPresentationAttributes.description: The paint used to fill the shape.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: fill-rule
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Algorithm deciding what is inside the shape.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: stroke
svgPresentationAttributes.description: The paint used to draw the outline.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: stroke-miterlimit
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Limit on the miter join length.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: transform
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Transform applied to the element and its children.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: color
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Value of the currentColor keyword for this subtree.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: clip-path
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Clip path applied to the element.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: clip-rule
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Fill rule used inside a clipPath.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: vector-effect
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Whether the stroke scales with the transform.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: pointer-events
svgPresentationAttributes.description: How the element responds to pointer hits.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: paint-order
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Order fill, stroke and markers are painted in.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: marker-start
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Marker drawn at the first vertex.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: marker-end
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Marker drawn at the last vertex.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: text-anchor
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Alignment of text relative to its position.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: dominant-baseline
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Baseline used to align the text.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: alignment-baseline
svgPresentationAttributes.description: How the element aligns to its parent's baseline.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: overflow
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Overflow behaviour for elements that establish a viewport.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: focusable
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Legacy IE/Edge attribute; false keeps inline SVG out of the tab order.

svgPresentationAttributes.name: systemLanguage
svgPresentationAttributes.description: Conditional processing: match against the user's language.

extraEvents.focusin: An element is about to receive focus. Bubbles, unlike focus.
extraEvents.focusout: An element is about to lose focus. Bubbles, unlike blur.
extraEvents.beforeinput: The value of an editable element is about to change.
extraEvents.compositionupdate: An IME composition session's text changed.
extraEvents.pointerdown: A pointer becomes active on the element.
extraEvents.pointerup: A pointer is released over the element.
extraEvents.pointermove: A pointer moves over the element.
extraEvents.pointerenter: A pointer enters the element. Does not bubble.
extraEvents.pointerleave: A pointer leaves the element. Does not bubble.
extraEvents.pointerover: A pointer moves onto the element.
extraEvents.pointerout: A pointer moves off the element.
extraEvents.pointercancel: The browser cancelled a pointer interaction.
extraEvents.touchstart: A touch point is placed on the element.
extraEvents.touchend: A touch point is removed from the element.
extraEvents.touchmove: A touch point moves along the element.
extraEvents.touchcancel: The browser cancelled a touch interaction.
extraEvents.animationiteration: A CSS animation completed an iteration.
extraEvents.wheel: A wheel or trackpad scrolled over the element.
extraEvents.fullscreenchange: The element entered or left fullscreen.
extraEvents.slotchange: The nodes assigned to a slot changed.
extraEvents.toggle: A details or popover element was opened or closed.
extraEvents.search: The user initiated a search in a search input.
extraEvents.visibilitychange: The document became visible or hidden.

svgElements.name: svg
svgElements.description: An SVG document fragment: the root of inline SVG.

attributes.name: viewBox
attributes.description: The coordinate system mapped onto the viewport: min-x min-y width height.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: x position when nested in another SVG.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: y position when nested in another SVG.

attributes.name: xmlns
attributes.description: The SVG namespace. Optional on inline SVG in HTML.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How the viewBox fits a viewport of a different aspect ratio.

svgElements.name: g
svgElements.description: A group of SVG elements sharing attributes and transforms.

svgElements.name: defs
svgElements.description: Definitions referenced elsewhere; never rendered directly.

svgElements.name: symbol
svgElements.description: A reusable graphic, instantiated with use.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How the viewBox fits the use viewport.

attributes.name: refX
attributes.description: x of the symbol's reference point.

attributes.name: refY
attributes.description: y of the symbol's reference point.

svgElements.name: use
svgElements.description: An instance of a symbol or any referenced element.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Reference to the element to instantiate.

svgElements.name: path
svgElements.description: A shape drawn from a path-data string.

attributes.name: d
attributes.description: The path data: move, line, curve and arc commands.

attributes.name: pathLength
attributes.description: Author-declared total length, for dash calculations.

svgElements.name: rect
svgElements.description: A rectangle, optionally with rounded corners.

svgElements.name: circle
svgElements.description: A circle.

svgElements.name: ellipse
svgElements.description: An ellipse.

svgElements.name: line
svgElements.description: A straight line between two points.

svgElements.name: polyline
svgElements.description: Connected straight lines, open.

svgElements.name: polygon
svgElements.description: Connected straight lines, closed.

svgElements.name: text
svgElements.description: Text rendered as SVG.

attributes.name: dx
attributes.description: Horizontal shift from the previous glyph.

attributes.name: dy
attributes.description: Vertical shift from the previous glyph.

attributes.name: textLength
attributes.description: Length the text is fitted to.

attributes.name: lengthAdjust
attributes.description: What is adjusted to fit textLength.

svgElements.name: tspan
svgElements.description: A span within SVG text.

attributes.name: dx
attributes.description: Horizontal shift from the previous glyph.

attributes.name: dy
attributes.description: Vertical shift from the previous glyph.

attributes.name: textLength
attributes.description: Length the text is fitted to.

attributes.name: lengthAdjust
attributes.description: What is adjusted to fit textLength.

svgElements.name: textPath
svgElements.description: Text laid out along a path.

attributes.name: startOffset
attributes.description: Where on the path the text starts.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: How glyphs are fitted to the path.

svgElements.name: image
svgElements.description: A raster or SVG image embedded in the graphic.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How the image fits its box.

svgElements.name: marker
svgElements.description: A graphic drawn at path vertices — arrowheads.

attributes.name: refX
attributes.description: x of the point that sits on the vertex.

attributes.name: refY
attributes.description: y of the point that sits on the vertex.

attributes.name: orient
attributes.description: Rotation of the marker at the vertex.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How the viewBox fits the marker viewport.

svgElements.name: clipPath
svgElements.description: A clipping region referenced by clip-path.

attributes.name: clipPathUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system of the clip contents.

svgElements.name: mask
svgElements.description: A luminance or alpha mask referenced by mask.

attributes.name: maskContentUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system of the mask contents.

svgElements.name: pattern
svgElements.description: A tiled fill pattern.

attributes.name: patternContentUnits
attributes.description: Coordinate system of the tile contents.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How the viewBox fits the tile.

svgElements.name: linearGradient
svgElements.description: A linear colour gradient.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: A gradient to inherit stops from.

svgElements.name: radialGradient
svgElements.description: A radial colour gradient.

attributes.name: cx
attributes.description: x of the end circle's centre.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.description: y of the end circle's centre.

attributes.name: fx
attributes.description: x of the start circle's centre.

attributes.name: fy
attributes.description: y of the start circle's centre.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: A gradient to inherit stops from.

svgElements.name: stop
svgElements.description: One colour stop in a gradient.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Position of the stop along the gradient.

svgElements.name: filter
svgElements.description: A filter-effect pipeline referenced by filter.

svgElements.name: feGaussianBlur
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: Gaussian blur.

svgElements.name: feOffset
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: offset the input.

svgElements.name: feBlend
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: blend two inputs.

svgElements.name: feColorMatrix
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: colour matrix transform.

svgElements.name: feComposite
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: Porter-Duff compositing.

svgElements.name: feFlood
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: fill with a colour.

svgElements.name: feImage
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: an external image.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How the image fits the region.

svgElements.name: feMerge
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: stack inputs.

svgElements.name: feMergeNode
svgElements.description: One input to feMerge.

svgElements.name: feMorphology
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: erode or dilate.

svgElements.name: feTurbulence
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: Perlin noise.

svgElements.name: feDisplacementMap
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: displace pixels by a map.

svgElements.name: feDropShadow
svgElements.description: Filter primitive: drop shadow.

svgElements.name: foreignObject
svgElements.description: A region of a foreign namespace — usually HTML — inside SVG.

svgElements.name: switch
svgElements.description: Renders the first child whose conditions match.

svgElements.name: view
svgElements.description: A named view of the document.

attributes.name: preserveAspectRatio
attributes.description: How the viewBox fits the viewport.

svgElements.name: desc
svgElements.description: A long-text description for accessibility.

svgElements.name: title
svgElements.description: A short title, shown as a tooltip in most browsers.

svgElements.name: metadata
svgElements.description: Machine-readable metadata.

svgElements.name: animate
svgElements.description: SMIL: animate an attribute over time.

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: freeze or remove after the animation.

svgElements.name: animateMotion
svgElements.description: SMIL: move an element along a path.

attributes.name: keyPoints
attributes.description: Progress along the path per keyTime.

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: freeze or remove after the animation.

svgElements.name: animateTransform
svgElements.description: SMIL: animate a transform.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: translate, scale, rotate, skewX or skewY.

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: freeze or remove after the animation.

svgElements.name: set
svgElements.description: SMIL: set an attribute for a duration.

svgElements.name: mpath
svgElements.description: SMIL: reference a path for animateMotion.

mathElements.name: math
mathElements.description: The root of a MathML formula.

mathElements.name: mi
mathElements.description: An identifier: variable, function name, constant.

attributes.name: mathvariant
attributes.description: Typographic variant, e.g. normal for upright.

attributes.name: largeop
attributes.description: Whether the operator enlarges in display style.

mathElements.name: mroot
mathElements.description: A root with an explicit index.

mathElements.name: msubsup
mathElements.description: A base with both subscript and superscript.

mathElements.name: munderover
mathElements.description: A base with both under- and overscript.

mathElements.name: mtd
mathElements.description: A cell of a mtable row.

mathElements.name: mpadded
mathElements.description: Adjusts the bounding box of its content.

mathElements.name: mphantom
mathElements.description: Content that takes space but is invisible.
